name: Rain
author: Amyang
description: Rain as real drops in the scene rather than two flat curtains — velocity-aligned streaks, depth-tested against the cast, so a drop passes behind a shoulder and in front of a hand in the same frame.

name: REZE DESIGN
author: Amyang
description: A flickering neon sign spelling REZE DESIGN — glyphs are plain line segments with an exponential glow. Transparent around the tubes.

name: Signature
author: Amyang
description: The maker's mark — the REZE DESIGN neon with 黯灭小羊 on a second row, same tube-and-halo glass. Transparent around the tubes.

name: Shining Stars
author: Amyang
description: A twinkling starfield that pans with the camera. Transparent between stars — your background color (or image) stays the sky.

name: Fireworks
author: Amyang
description: Eight shells on a rotation, no two the same size: each climbs on an eased arc, bursts into a fan that falls away under gravity trailing hot streaks, and about two in five of those sparks crackle again into embers. Ported from Gatomoi. SPEED slows the whole display, BOOM sizes the burst, TRAIL is how long the streaks run, PARTICLES is the cost dial.

name: Hand Ribbon
author: amyang-xyz
description: A neon ribbon along the path each hand actually took, drawn as spline-smoothed geometry — with its sparks as real GPU particles spawned on the same trail. The first effect using two mounts in one file.

name: Footprints
author: amyang-xyz
description: Marks where the feet met the ground, each burning down like a candle — the disc dims and draws in while embers rise off it and fade. Contacts are inferred from the moment a foot's recorded path stops descending, so a step leaves one print rather than forty overlapping discs.

name: Stage Lights
author: amyang-xyz
description: Three follow-spots — left, overhead, right — placed relative to the camera and aimed at the floor under each character. The beams are marched through the air, so they are cut off by whatever they fall behind.

name: Snow
author: amyang-xyz
description: Three thousand flakes as instanced geometry rather than a fullscreen march — drifting on curl noise, depth-tested against the cast, and following the camera so the scene snows wherever you orbit.

name: Waveform
author: amyang-xyz
description: After mafik's Shadertoy visualiser (shadertoy.com/view/XsjGz3), ported onto the audio data interface: twenty spectrum bands each bend a travelling cosine through the frame, amplitude from each band's peakiness against its neighbours, with the classic 1/|y| glow drawn around the composed curve — deep blue into glowing red, beating with the song, identical in the editor and the export.

name: Vyke's Dragonbolt
author: amyang-xyz
description: Red fire-lightning clinging to a body, after Elden Ring. Arcs ring the LIMBS rather than the joints — anywhere along a neck, torso, arm, thigh or shin — on tilted rings that swing behind her and back out again, so the half of each ring behind a shoulder is hidden by that shoulder. Every channel forks off its own tangent and restrikes five times a second.

name: Summoning Circle
author: amyang-xyz
description: A magic sigil on the ground under each character, in neon purple, with a shaft of light standing on it: three chords struck across a triangle, a rimmed ring whose outer stroke breathes on a trapezoidal wave, nested triangles and a hexagon, and a hexagram set into a disc at each vertex. The figure is a port of nayk's summoningCircle() — https://www.shadertoy.com/view/M3KGD3 — which credits https://glslsandbox.com/e#109235.1 and https://www.shadertoy.com/view/43V3zG. Laid on the world ground plane at the subject's floor point and depth-tested by hand, so her legs cut into it.

name: Immolation
author: amyang-xyz
description: The upper body alight, after Elden Ring's flame incantations. Six upper-body segments become a silhouette field, and one domain-warped noise field — sampled on a vertically stretched lattice, measured with up cheap and down expensive — carves curling tongues off the shoulders, head and arms. Faint where it crosses her, so the character stays readable through the fire.

name: Dry Ice
author: amyang-xyz
description: A fluid on the floor, marched as a volume: velocity, density and pressure in one grid, advected and projected every frame, then lit by a single lamp overhead with everything falling off around it. Density is injected from two scales of noise and bled off continuously, so the bank never settles; her feet clear it and drag it shut behind them. A port of David Gallardo (xjorma)'s shadertoy fog — Image and Buffers A–D.

name: Note Fall
author: Amyang
description: Reads the track's MIDI: glowing bars fall onto a piano keyboard along the bottom of the frame, lighting the key each note belongs to. Screen-space background, additive, full-res.

name: Lyrics
author: Amyang
description: Karaoke subtitles for the track's lyrics, broadcast style — a bold line low on the screen, white glyphs in a dark rim, the sung fraction wiping to colour. Pair an .lrc with the track (X.mp3 beside X.lrc); the shader owns the look.

name: Water Pool
author: Amyang
description: A pool the cast stands chest-deep in — the waterline rings the body with depth-based foam, legs show through the shallows and fade into the deep, and ripples glint without a single particle.
